title.original: OrchVis: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Orchestration for Human Oversight
title.zh: OrchVis：用于人工监督的分层多代理编排
title.en: OrchVis: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Orchestration for Human Oversight

inclusion_reason.zh: OrchVis 将目标树、依赖、验证和人工重规划封装为通用监督控制面，而非针对单一 Agent 应用的界面。
inclusion_reason.en: OrchVis packages goal trees, dependencies, verification, and human replanning as a general oversight control plane rather than an application-specific interface.

abstract.zh: OrchVis 将多 Agent 协作的层级目标、任务分配、依赖、验证与冲突解决可视化，让人类在不逐步微操的情况下监督复杂执行。用户意图被解析为结构化目标，系统持续验证执行并在冲突时给出可选重规划。
abstract.en: OrchVis visualizes hierarchical goals, task assignment, dependencies, verification, and conflict resolution so people can oversee complex multi-agent execution without micromanaging every step. It structures user intent, monitors progress, and presents alternative replans when conflicts arise.

problem.zh: 随着 Agent 数与依赖增加，人类难以理解协作如何对应原始目标，也无法在不接管所有步骤的情况下发现冲突和选择性干预。
problem.en: As agent count and dependencies grow, supervisors struggle to see how collaboration serves the original goal or intervene selectively without taking over the whole workflow.

approach.zh: 框架把用户意图分解为层级目标，按目标分配 Agent 与任务，以自动验证器监控结果，并在依赖冲突时生成可供人选择的重规划分支。
approach.en: The framework decomposes intent into hierarchical goals, assigns agents and tasks, monitors results with automated verification, and generates human-selectable replan branches when dependencies conflict.

system_design.zh: OrchVis 的规划面板呈现目标树、Agent—任务映射和跨 Agent 依赖；验证器把运行状态反馈到图中，冲突管理器提供局部替代方案并保留人工批准点。
system_design.en: An interactive planning panel renders the goal tree, agent–task mapping, and inter-agent dependencies. Verifiers feed execution state back into the graph, while conflict management offers local alternatives behind human approval points.

key_results.zh: 论文的主要贡献是把透明可视化、层级目标对齐和自适应自治组合为可监督的多 Agent 编排机制；摘要未给出量化用户研究结果。
key_results.en: The main contribution is an oversight mechanism combining transparent visualization, hierarchical goal alignment, and adaptive autonomy; the abstract does not report quantitative user-study results.

limitations.zh: 有效监督依赖目标解析和自动验证的正确性，复杂图也可能造成新的认知负担；摘要未量化用户决策质量、规模上限或恶意 Agent 场景。
limitations.en: Oversight depends on correct goal parsing and verification, and large graphs may create new cognitive load; decision quality, scale limits, and adversarial agents are not quantified in the abstract.

workloads: human oversight of hierarchical multi-agent collaboration

notes.zh: 监督场景和系统能力来自官方摘要；摘要未给出模型、硬件、用户数、任务集或量化指标，相关评测待全文审计。
notes.en: The oversight setting and system capabilities come from the official abstract; it states no models, hardware, user count, task set, or quantitative metrics, all of which await full-text audit.
